newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Hambrecht & Quist to take stake in Israeli firm.
newsitem.headline: Hambrecht & Quist to take stake in Israeli firm.

text.p: U.S. investment bank Hambrecht & Quist is taking a 33 percent stake in newly formed Israeli investment bank Tamir, Fishman & Co for $2 million, Tamir Fishman said on Wednesday.
Under the agreement Tamir Fishman will act as Hambrecht's Israeli agent. The accord will be formally signed next month when Daniel Case, Hambrecht's CEO and president, is in Israel.

Tamir Fishman, which was formed last month, will specialise in technology finance. It will offer financial services to investors, aid in corporate finance, manage securities portfolios and private funds, and perform other related services.

Eldad Tamir, one of the two partners that will control the other 67 percent of Tamir Fishman, said the accord marked the first time a U.S. investment bank was taking an equity position in an Israeli investment bank.
Hambrecht, which specialises in technology companies, led offerings in the Israeli companies Tecnomatix Technologies Ltd and Mercury Interactive public in 1993 and Opal Inc in 1995.
